name: eventfold-monorepo
description: A fold layer over a memory backend: eventfold (runtime + builder), fold-guard (guards), dossier (topic dossiers).

scripts.test: npm run test -w fold-guard && npm run test -w dossier && npm run test:runtime -w eventfold
scripts.lint: node --check packages/fold-guard/src/index.mjs && node --check packages/dossier/src/index.mjs && node --check packages/eventfold/src/archive.mjs
